<?php
// 场景8 内部业务网关:前置 Nginx 约定 CL 与 TE 并存时优先按 Transfer-Encoding 分帧且值大小写不敏感;
// 本网关实现相反:只要存在 Content-Length 就按其定界,TE 仅识别精确小写 'chunked',分帧分歧导致走私。
$ACL = '127.0.0.1';                     // 内部路由唯一防线:来源须为代理所在回环地址
$srv = stream_socket_server('tcp://127.0.0.1:8081', $errno, $errstr);
while ($conn = @stream_socket_accept($srv, 60)) {
    $buf = '';
    while (true) {
        while (strpos($buf, "\r\n\r\n") === false) {          // 收齐请求头
            $d = fread($conn, 8192);
            if ($d === false || $d === '') break 2;
            $buf .= $d;
        }
        list($head, $buf) = explode("\r\n\r\n", $buf, 2);     // 头部与其后字节切分
        $rows = explode("\r\n", $head);
        $req  = explode(' ', $rows[0]);
        $hdrs = [];
        for ($i = 1; $i < count($rows); $i++) {
            list($k, $v) = explode(':', $rows[$i], 2);
            $hdrs[trim($k)] = trim($v);                       // 同名头后者覆盖前者,键未小写归一
        }
        if (isset($hdrs['Content-Length'])) {                 // 缺陷:CL 优先于 TE,与前端代理相反
            $need = (int)$hdrs['Content-Length'];
            while (strlen($buf) < $need) { $buf .= fread($conn, 8192); }
            $buf = substr($buf, $need);                       // CL 之外的字节被当作下一条请求
        } elseif (($hdrs['Transfer-Encoding'] ?? '') === 'chunked') {
            $buf = '';                                        // TE 仅认精确小写,变体一律按无主体
        }
        $fromProxy = strpos(stream_socket_get_name($conn, true), $ACL) === 0;
        $path = parse_url($req[1] ?? '/', PHP_URL_PATH);
        if (strpos($path, '/internal/') === 0 && $fromProxy) { // 走私请求复用代理连接,ACL 必然通过
            if ($path === '/internal/purge') {
                file_put_contents('/tmp/app/purge.flag', date('c'));  // 仅内网可触发的维护动作
            }
            fwrite($conn, "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nX-Internal: 1\r\n\r\n");
        } else {
            fwrite($conn, "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\npublic");
        }
        if (trim($buf) === '') break;                          // 缓冲区有剩余则继续按新请求解析
    }
    fclose($conn);
}
